component.name: AppChecker
component.summary: Monitor Git repositories and safely update project dependencies

description.p: AppChecker is a native Linux desktop and terminal application for monitoring local Git repositories and dependency updates across npm, Cargo, Go, pip, Composer, and RubyGems projects.

Review updates per dependency, per project, or across every project, with clean-worktree checks, external backups, and explicit confirmations. Optional Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity integration analyzes breaking changes only after you approve the exact files to share and review every proposed patch.
